mapper.select: SELECT d.dog_id, d.dog_name, gb.gubn_name AS breed, d.is_mix, d.dog_intro, gp.gubn_name AS personality_type, d.profile_url FROM tbl_dogs d LEFT JOIN tbl_gubn gb ON gb.gubn_code = d.breed AND gb.group_code = 'breed_code' LEFT JOIN tbl_gubn gp ON gp.gubn_code = d.personality_type AND gp.group_code = 'dog_type_code' WHERE dog_id = #{dogId}
